name: Akira
source:
Member of the school newspaper club of Rindoukan Academy, and friend of [url=/c89920]Usagawa Yukiko[/url].
She is the coolest of the three. At times she has quarrels with [url=/c124710]Yuna[/url], but probably it's Yuna's fault.
